framework_prefixes.description: Frames starting with one of these prefixes are framework frames; the others are highlighted as your code in zoom, e.g. [java., org.springframework.].

stream.description: The line on the logs screen. Its columns are the ones c hides one by one and C toggles.

columns.description: Columns drawn before the message, in this order, separated by one space.

hide_below.description: stream only: hidden automatically when the terminal is narrower than this many cells, until you choose columns.

key.description: stream only: one letter toggling the column in the columns picker (C). p, z, r and f are taken.

name.description: Column name, unique in the line; shown in the columns picker and the status bar.

role.description: Color role from the theme. time columns follow ctrl+t; level columns hidden make WARN messages colored. Default plain.

show.description: Template of the column, e.g. "[{thread|last:15|right:15}]". A column whose text is empty is left out.

visible.description: stream only: shown when a logs screen opens. Default true.

separator.description: Text between the columns and the message.

after.description: Shown only when one of these columns is shown. Empty: whenever any column is shown.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.

zoom.description: The first line of the zoom view (enter). Default: the stream line.
